items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: That was their lineup. Landry, Schatz, and Willie Wilson. Johnny Wilson on baritone, and Verrett on tuba. ... Connish and I, and Flowers on that alto

ctx.x: When did Landry come to town?

No, Landry, let's see. No, I believe, yeah, Landry was with him. Yeah, Landry was with him because I used to kid, Landry, begging a cigarette. That's how I do that. Lick his fingers. He meant for somebody to give him a cigarette, you see. Yeah. That's what we used to get a kick out of it. So when I first saw him do that, I didn't know what he was talking about. Then the fellow would say he's begging for cigarettes. Yeah, he would be begging for cigarettes. That was their lineup. Landry, Schatz, and Willie Wilson.…
